comparison.objective: Hold a marked part at height while closing a bench vise; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually support and align a workpiece while rotating a vise knob to clamp it versus loosen a captive lock, adjust a small collar, relock, clear, and test.
comparison.success_condition: Part clamped upright with its line at jaw height versus two force- and travel-compliant stops without drift or damage.
comparison.reason: Knob rotation and clamping are generic overlap; only the candidate requires iterative dynamic-response validation.
